Package NodeSections

package NodeSections
Node sections, the building blocks from which the JSIM simulation engine stations are composed. Each station (source, sink, queue, delay, fork, join, router, logger, class switch, semaphore, scaler, transition and place) is assembled from node sections that implement its distinct behaviours.
